records.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Make one photorealistic 1536x1024 landscape character sheet on neutral grey studio background. Exactly eight panels, two rows of four. Top row: front full body, left profile full body, back full body, three-quarter full body. Bottom row: front face close-up, right face profile, low angle face, looking-down face. Same face, age, clothing, jewellery and body in every panel. Image 1 is local Chutia man clothing construction reference: keep short-sleeve Chutia sula, wrapped Churia lower garment and cloth paguri; remove its gamusa entirely. Image 2 is current Dhirnarayan sheet for layout, realistic rendering and clothing family only, never copy his face. Apply the individual design below. No neck gamusa, scarf, shoulder shawl or loose chest drape. Bare feet. Royal status through fine silk, woven trim and restrained gold only. Never use an Ahom crown, Mughal robe, Dimasa crossed chest cloth, modern ceremonial medals, sequins, fantasy armour or elaborate Rajput turban. Do not introduce a tilak, sacred thread or sectarian beads unless separately instructed. Natural anatomy, relaxed hands, unobstructed garments. All faces, apparent ages, colours, decorative patterns and royal accessories are artistic choices, not authenticated historical portraits. No readable invented inscription, no floating labels on clothing, no extra people, objects, animals or inset panels. Do not include optional research props in this eight-view sheet. A specified sheathed waist sword may appear worn. Small serif view labels, title exactly as specified, footer ARTISTIC RECONSTRUCTION. Subject title: "LAKSHMINARAYANA". Apparent age 45 (design choice). Face/build: Broad forehead, squared cheeks, straight nose, short neatly clipped black moustache, clean chin, medium strong build, calm direct gaze. Costume: Honey-gold muga-look short-sleeve hip-length Chutia sula, narrow red stepped geometric edging, ivory Churia dhoti with a single red border, deep vermilion Tongali waist sash. Head: Ivory wrapped paguri following the local man's construction, medium-height folded end, narrow gold band with small rectangular central plaque. Jewellery: Small round gold studs, one modest round pendant on a fine chain, one narrow engraved cuff. Prop guidance: Optional separate inset of a plain fired brick and copper-plate grant; neither held in the standard turnaround, no invented readable inscription. Key recognition cue: warm gold, stepped red border, rectangular brow plaque.
